spans.text: Saint spirits are echoes of the original warriors who left their mark on the world as the progenitor of a sword saint’s path. They are the same spirits that can become progenitors for sword saints who would channel them through the Way of the Progenitor. These spirits exist to guide those who would follow in their footsteps, and serve as powerful elemental forces that cannot be fully expelled from the living world, and have removed themselves from the cycle of reincarnation.

Saint spirits can become corrupted if a relic of a saint is tainted by powerful dark magic, and some specialized spiritualists may be able to manifest echoes of these spirits as their familiars, though they find them difficult to control. These controlled versions are rarely the true saint spirit, and are usually a dark echo instead.

Just as false Eidolons can be formed from warped cultural views of eidolic deities, a special type of yokai exists that is a grim reflection of the saint spirit - the dead master. Dead masters are reflections of saint spirits that take pleasure in terrorizing those who would look up to a spirit saint ethnically, and often will present themselves as the vengeful soul of a saint spirit come to take revenge on the world. Unlike false Eidolons, they know they are not the true saint spirit and instead are its grim reflection, and so will usually take on their own name to separate their identity.

A dead master yokai uses the same stat block as a saint spirit, except its creature type becomes “fiend (yokai).” It gains a fly (hover) speed of 30 feet, and it gains the Magic Resistance and Yokai Nourishment traits.
